title: Hearts Turned Away from the Clear Truth

paragraphs.text: Allah never places on any soul more than its capacity. He has a record that speaks the truth, and no one will be wronged. But the disbelievers' hearts are confused about this, and they keep doing evil deeds. When punishment seizes their wealthy people, they cry out for help. They will be told not to cry today, because no help will come. Allah's verses were recited to them, but they turned back. They were proud and spoke evil at night.

Have they not thought deeply about the Quran? Did they not know their Messenger? Do they say he is mad? No, he brought them the truth, but most of them hate the truth. If the truth followed their desires, the heavens and the earth would be ruined. The Prophet does not ask them for payment, because his Lord's reward is best. He invites them to a straight path, but those who reject the Hereafter leave the path.

Even if Allah showed them mercy and removed their trouble, they would continue wandering blindly in their wrongdoing. He touched them with suffering, but they did not humble themselves before their Lord. When a door of severe punishment opens, they will fall into despair. Allah gave you hearing, sight and hearts, but you are rarely grateful.

hardWords.m: how much someone can carry or do
